verdict.rationale: Discord's own blog documents Threads as a way to branch conversations off a channel's main feed, including private threads (discord-docs-37, discord-docs-38), which supports organizing busy channels by topic. However, independent community evidence directly contradicts the 'catch up efficiently' claim: users report Discord is 'very chaotic when a lot of people are posting' and messages are poorly indexed/hard to search (discord-comm-9), and that content has 'no discoverability' and the UI is hard to navigate (discord-comm-11). Missing for 10: no first-party docs on named channel topics/topic fields, no evidence addressing search/catch-up efficiency claims, and no rebuttal to the chaos/discoverability complaints.
